title: Approved URL to cleaned frame to bounded I2V
best_for: turning an owner-supplied reference URL into transformed face-free motion
extracting one truthful scenic frame rather than copying a source edit
avoid_when: reuse rights or owner approval are unknown
the source has no cleanable face-free frame
a direct recut is the actual requested deliverable
source_contract: Review the full source before frame selection
Gate people, faces, reflections, embedded text, logos, and unwanted objects
Preserve architecture, perspective, crop, and material facts during cleanup
creative_contract: Run one bounded I2V sample before batching
Default to HappyHorse for standalone hero quality
Use wan2.6-i2v-flash for low-cost locked-camera motion inside a larger composition
qa_contract: Reject any human remnant or embedded text
Reject new buildings, facilities, furniture, boats, horizon features, views, or geometry
Treat PASS_WITH_NOTES as FAIL when any note matches a hard rejection
Record tool-capability and creative-result verdicts separately
Review motion output before generating additional shots
Record provider, model, seed, cost, task, and output provenance
hard_rejections: public visibility treated as reuse permission
camera move revealing an invented building, boat, landform, facility, furniture, or material view
furniture or architecture morph dismissed as minor provider noise
provider substitution hidden from the record
batch generation before the first sample passes

canonical_artifacts.role: accepted samples, costs, sources, and owner routing rule

notes: Follow the skill stage by stage
Stop for owner approval before any paid I2V call
One sample is not permission to batch

proof.disposition: Owner accepted HappyHorse as the quality lane and Wan Flash as the still-animation composition lane
proof.qa: Clean-frame gates passed; accepted Wan sample contains no people, new building, or geometry drift
